name: Full-Time Hunt
source:
Noah Emery thought his day couldn't get any worse after an awkward live interview with Dr. Bill. Little did he know, not even hours later he'd have a fateful encounter with the notorious hitman; Null. 

Noah must now navigate a strange game of cat an mouse with a serial killer. Gathering evidence to protect himself and possibly take Null down himself. Yet, as Noah gets to know Null better over time, he begins to learn that things are not what they seem. 

[From [url=https://futotori.itch.io/full-time-hunt]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
诺亚·埃默里 (Noah Emery) 在与比尔博士进行了一次尴尬的现场采访后认为他的日子再糟糕不过了。他几乎不知道，甚至几个小时后，他就与臭名昭著的杀手发生了命运般的遭遇。无效的。

诺亚现在必须应对一场猫鼠与连环杀手的奇怪游戏。收集证据来保护自己，并可能让Null自己下台。然而，随着时间的推移，诺亚对Null有了更多的了解，他开始了解到事情并不像看上去的那样。

[来自[url=https://futotori.itch.io/full-time-hunt]itch.io[/url]]
